units.rawText: A Black Limb descends from the light. It is a limb that doesn't move the way I want.

spans.text: A Black Limb descends from the light. It is a limb that doesn't move the way I want.

units.rawText: Oh my, already trying to grab my hand as I enter? What an ill-mannered actor you are.
units.displayText: Oh my, already trying to grab my hand as I enter? What an ill-mannered actor you are.

spans.text: Oh my, already trying to grab my hand as I enter? What an ill-mannered actor you are.

units.rawText: I can't control it. The limb won't listen to me. The limb is moving on its own.
units.displayText: I can't control it. The limb won't listen to me. The limb is moving on its own.

spans.text: I can't control it. The limb won't listen to me. The limb is moving on its own.

units.rawText: I've never seen a limb like this before. I keep tugging on it. It keeps dodging.
units.displayText: I've never seen a limb like this before. I keep tugging on it. It keeps dodging.

spans.text: I've never seen a limb like this before. I keep tugging on it. It keeps dodging.

units.rawText: That won't do. Controlling other actors is a no-no.
units.displayText: That won't do. Controlling other actors is a no-no.

spans.text: That won't do. Controlling other actors is a no-no.

units.rawText: However, I am willing to serve as your limbs for this performance.
units.displayText: However, I am willing to serve as your limbs for this performance.

spans.text: However, I am willing to serve as your limbs for this performance.

units.rawText: My... limbs...?
units.displayText: My... limbs...?

spans.text: My... limbs...?

units.rawText: You're still largely unaware of your characterization, eh? That's alright, take your time and read the script. As it happens, time is what we have in abundance.
